MV1_QUOTE_FIDELITY: SUBSTANTIAL PASS WITH RECORD-LEVEL FAILURES. I re-fetched the arXiv HTML of all five papers and searched every numeric claim the packet forwards. Verified verbatim in source: 80-94% zero-shot compilation success; Table 2 (T1 50 attempts/46/92%/98.0%, T2 10/8/80%/95.0%, T3 50/47/94%/96.0%); $0.002-$0.092 per-compilation across five frontier models (Table 1 min $0.0020, max $0.0916); O(MxN)->amortized O(1); $150.00 unoptimized and $15.00 at 90% caching; 'typically bi-annually or annually'; Auto 87.1% of 560 spans, 59->2 microdollars (6.4x), 96.9% parity, 48.9% (133/272), K=8, $0.0621, 2,775 vs 17,692 microdollars, 18.2 microseconds; TraceCompiler 0.928/0.943 over 15,775 def-use edges, 0.992 on 250 edges, 0.993 over 563 token edges, 34->11, 15 of 21, 51.4% median removable (IQR 41.9-74.1%), support floor 5, 'we claim no net efficiency result'; TSCG >=51% bound, 50-72% savings, 52-57% on heavy MCP, ARR 108-181% across three models, ~19,000 calls, 12 models, 84.4%/90.3%, R2 0.88->0.03, <1ms vs 42.5s, '1,200 LOC TypeScript, zero dependencies'; Compiled AI 96% (384/400), break-even ~17 transactions, 57x and 84x at 1K, 4.5ms vs 2,004ms, $555 vs $22,000 (40x) at 1M tx/month, 9,600 gen tokens, 95.8%/100% and 75%/100%. Failures: (1) extractions.json record 11 puts prior-packet prose in verbatim_quote (secondary source, forbidden by MV1); (2) record 12's verbatim_quote is a paraphrase; (3) record 2's verbatim_quote splices an Abstract sentence with a Section 4.1 sentence across an undisclosed elision and its extracted_value ($0.002-$0.092) does not match the quoted text ($0.002 to $0.10) - both fragments are genuine, the splice is the defect.

MV1_SOURCE_INDEPENDENCE: FAIL as a systematic property, unrecorded by the producer. Every quantitative claim in this packet is author-self-evaluated: Auto-Bench is 'a benchmark we introduce and pre-register' (arXiv:2607.04542), TSCG-Agentic-Bench is the TSCG authors' own (~19,000 calls, 12 models, 5 scenarios), arXiv:2604.09718 is an 'Internal evaluation' on proprietary enterprise DOMs whose Section 5.1 states the reliance on them 'limits independent replication', and arXiv:2608.02680's headline dependency metrics are on its own training split. There is zero independent replication anywhere in the evidence base. The prior packet's audit recorded this ('Single observations per system, no independent replications'); this packet did not carry it forward, and it is the most important threat to a packet whose purpose is to set an external error-rate bar for C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE.

MV2_RUNNABILITY: FAIL AS SCORED. The producer set mv2_pass=true while disclosing (provenance.json extraction_methodology.mv2_compliance, result.json validity_notes[5]) that runnability rested on 'GitHub repo inspection ... and paper claims'. The frozen MV2 forbids inference from paper claims alone. arXiv:2604.09718 has no artifact URL of any kind; arXiv:2608.02680 has no URL for its own released skill package. I independently verified the repos that do exist: RightNow-AI/auto (Rust, Apache-2.0, 128 stars, last push 2026-07-07), SKZL-AI/tscg (TypeScript, MIT, 23 stars, last push 2026-07-03, package.json v1.4.3, dependencies=null, devDependencies present, engines node>=18 - so 'zero dependencies' is accurate as a RUNTIME-dependency claim and requires a build step for the package). Stars recorded in provenance (122, 24) have drifted to (128, 23) - ordinary drift, not fabrication. The direction of the MV2 error is conservative (it produced a 'not runnable' verdict, not a positive one), which is why this audit's status is REVISE rather than MEASUREMENT_INVALID; see unresolved[0].

MV3_COMPARABILITY: SATISFIED FORMALLY BUT VACUOUS AS A CONDITION. All five systems are certified INCOMPARABLE to SPIDER's alias-OOD, and the producer's per-system incomparability statements are accurate and specific (live web vs local HTTP; browser vs no browser; DOM vs API; recorded agent spans vs parameterized routing; AppWorld 9 apps/457 APIs/56 scenarios vs single-app routing; BFCL 400 function-calling instances vs HTTP routing; schema compression vs task execution). The finding is honest and is the packet's most useful negative result. But C3_COMPARABILITY_ASSESSED as frozen requires only 'an explicit statement of comparability/incomparability', so it is satisfied by declaring everything incomparable and carries no positive information. It cannot be counted as a passed scientific gate alongside C2, and it directly contradicts the numeric recommendations in report.md Section 5.

MV4_CONFLATION: PASS, and the strongest part of the packet. Conflation flagging is accurate and independently confirmed: arXiv:2607.04542 'records live agent behavior' and its ratchet 'recompiles from new deopt traces' (inheritance then compile); arXiv:2608.02680 'mines clusters of noisy agent traces' so 'Compilation INPUT is inherited/recorded behavior'; TSCG is pure schema compilation with 'no model access is required'; Compiled AI is one-time generation from a YAML spec with no behavioral recording. Agentic Compilation is genuinely clean on this axis. Note for the Director: the one system clean of conflation is the one that is non-replicable and internally evaluated, and the three systems with published quantitative regimes are the three that conflate compilation with inheritance - which is itself a substantive finding for C-PRODUCT-ECON that the packet does not state.

MV5_NUMERICAL_THRESHOLDS: PASS AS EXTRACTION, INCOMPLETE AS SPECIFIED. The mandate asked for reuse count, witnessed-determinism fraction, novelty rate, task length, build cost AND 'the build-cost and amortization accounting convention used', plus staleness/maintenance. The thresholds are there; the accounting conventions are not (see required_fixes). Also incomplete: arXiv:2608.02680 has TWO distinct support thresholds - the clustering 'support floor is 5' and the skill's own abstention rule 'Do not compile a cluster with fewer than three independent executions' / 'abstains ... when fewer than three traces support a structural claim'. The packet records only 5, and 3 is the binding-relevant abstention floor for C1 and for any Product reuse-count threshold.

MV6_STALENESS: PASS AS RECORDING, WEAK AS A VALUE. 'NOT REPORTED' is correctly used for arXiv:2608.02680 and arXiv:2605.04107 rather than zero. However arXiv:2604.09718's 'typically bi-annually or annually' is an unquantified author assertion used by that paper to rebut an overstatement of staleness risk, and the paper reports no maintenance cost; the packet forwards it to Frontier as a novelty-rate regime input as though it were a measured rate. The genuinely informative staleness datum in the packet is Auto's 48.9% silent wrongness under a deliberately loose guard, and the packet does record it.

CONTROL_NC_FABRICATED_BINDING_CLAIMS: REPRODUCED BUT NON-DISCRIMINATING. I independently searched the arXiv HTML of all five papers for the three fabricated strings and found zero occurrences of each, reproducing NC's PASS. The control is nonetheless vacuous as specified: it tests for three literal phrases no paper would contain, and it has zero power against the failure mode that actually occurred in this packet. While NC was searching for fabricated claims, the packet silently substituted a different artifact under the mandated 'COVENANT' label and scored C-conditions over the substituted denominator; NC PASSes and did not detect this. A negative control must be able to fail.

CONTROL_PC_MV6_REPRODUCIBILITY: REPRODUCES, BUT IS CIRCULAR AND HAS NO STATED PRECISION. The control re-extracts parameters that the same agent lineage extracted from the same five papers in EXP-INTEL-36249068574, so agreement demonstrates intra-lineage consistency, not correctness - and the claimed match cannot detect any error that is constant along the lineage, which is exactly the class of error present (a crossed name-to-artifact mapping and a mis-scoped metric). 'within stated precision' is stated nowhere. The hot-path latency row is a PASS by concatenating Auto's 18.2 microsecond in-process Node floor with Compiled AI's 4.5 ms BFCL P50 - two different systems on two different benchmarks forming one 'verified' range, and the Auto floor is measured 'on a trivial artifact rather than model inference' while the same paper's measured compiled-answer latency is 65.7 ms (3,610x the floor). The baseline's token-cost row is likewise composite: TSCG is a schema compiler with no per-task execution, so its zero marginal token cost is not a per-task token cost.

ENVIRONMENT_EXPRESSION: the tested effect COULD be expressed in the observed environment only for arXiv:2605.04107 (SKZL-AI/tscg: dependencies=null, Node >=18, MIT, verified). For arXiv:2604.09718 and arXiv:2608.02680 no artifact exists to run; for arXiv:2607.04542 the runtime needs a Rust/wasmtime build and recording needs a frontier LLM; for arXiv:2604.05150 the orchestration needs Temporal. The packet's c4_runnability_verified=false is the correct direction and is not an infrastructure failure being encoded as a negative scientific result - the producer correctly reported the substrate as absent rather than inferring a result from it.

baseline_findings: B-MV6-NO-MEMORY-EXECUTOR: SPECIFIED, NOT A SINGLE SYSTEM, AND MATERIALLY FAVOURABLE TO THE EXECUTOR. Producer marks PASS; audit marks SPECIFIED-COMPOSITE-AND-UNVALIDATED. The baseline is a cross-system composite: compilation cost from arXiv:2604.09718, witnessed-determinism and the latency ladder from arXiv:2607.04542, refusal evidence from arXiv:2608.02680, schema compression from arXiv:2605.04107, latency and TCO from arXiv:2604.05150. No consulted system instantiates all of it, so it cannot serve as a single strong baseline. Its hot-path latency is understated by about three orders of magnitude: the 18.2 microsecond endpoint is Auto's in-process Node dispatch floor measured 'on a trivial artifact rather than model inference', while the same paper's Table 2 measures 65.7 ms per compiled answer for families F1/F2-classify/F4 (audit-recomputed ratio 3,610x). Its 'token cost 0 on repeats' endpoint is TSCG's, a schema compiler with no per-task execution, plus Compiled AI's zero runtime tokens, which hold by construction on BFCL function-calling. Three lanes (Graph, Product, Frontier) were told to beat this bar; the bar is optimistic and has no single owner.

PC-MV6-REPRODUCIBILITY: PASS AS AN EXTRACTED ARTIFACT, FAIL AS A CONTROL. It reproduces the composite described above from the same papers, by the same lineage, with no stated precision, and its strongest-looking row (hot-path latency) is a two-system splice. It cannot detect a constant-lineage error. It must be restated as intra-lineage consistency evidence, and the 'abstention/refusal present' row must carry the caveat that the only source publishing abstention NUMBERS is arXiv:2607.04542 (gate refusals: 3 gate-refused in leg B, F3 refused at all three rungs, F2-priority FAIL on 3 divergent-witness groups, F5 FAIL 17/40) and that arXiv:2608.02680 explicitly publishes NO compile/decline rate, calling it instead 'the adoption-relevant number'.

B-PRIOR-INTEL-EXTRACTIONS: PASS, independently confirmed. All five named continuity values match EXP-INTEL-36249068574/result.json metrics exactly: agentic_compilation_per_compilation_cost_min_usd=0.002, determinism_witnessed_fraction_auto=0.871, tracecompiler_precision=0.928, tscg_formal_compression_bound=0.51, compiledai_token_efficiency_x=57. I then verified each against the papers themselves, and each is correct. Audit-recomputation of arXiv:2607.04542's pooled census from its own family rows: (80*1.000 + 320*0.775 + 80 + 80)/560 = 0.8714, matching the published 87.1%; arXiv:2608.02680's 248/250 = 0.992. This is the packet's most solid result and it establishes that the extraction pipeline is faithful to sources. It does not establish correctness of anything the prior packet and this packet agreed on wrongly.

B-CROSSSITE-HIERARCHICAL: NOT TESTED, CORRECTLY LABELLED. Producer records pass_fail='CARRIED_FORWARD' and did not re-evaluate. Honest, and it is not a defect, but the packet therefore ships an architectural baseline it did not examine, sourced from the parent handoff's established list (arXiv:2603.07024, 2606.17645, 2412.07958). The prior packet's audit already bounded it to 'hierarchical significantly outperforms flat on Mind2Web/WebArena/CAP benchmarks', not 'flat reuse is a known failure mode'. Downstream lanes must not read this baseline as re-validated by EXP-INTEL-36272389571.

NO_NULL_BASELINE_FOR_THE_EXTRACTION_PROCEDURE: absent, and this is the packet's structural weakness. The frozen packet supplied one positive and one null control, but the null control tests for fabricated sentences rather than for mis-identified artifacts, and there is no control that would have caught the crossed COVENANT/TraceCompiler/Auto mapping. The design-level consequence is that the packet's central negative capability claim ('no system publishes a binding error rate') rests on a search whose recall over the target list is unmeasured - one of five mandated targets was never located and the packet still reports a 5-system denominator.

STRONG-BASELINE-DISCIPLINE VERDICT: not met for the purpose the mandate assigned to this baseline. The mandate's stated consumer use is Product's break-even reuse count and Frontier's headroom decomposition. The packet supplies numbers (n*=17, 87.1%, K=8, 65.7 ms, 40x) whose accounting conventions, denominators and self-authored-benchmark status were not recorded, and simultaneously certifies all of them incomparable to SPIDER's distribution. A baseline that is simultaneously 'incomparable' and 'use these exact numbers' is not a strong baseline; it is a set of un-transferable reference points.

claim_ceiling: MAXIMUM JUSTIFIED CLAIM CEILING for EXP-INTEL-36272389571, bounded below the producer's written ceiling. The packet establishes, from primary sources this audit independently re-fetched and verified: (1) ADDRESSING - of the five frozen target labels, exactly one source (arXiv:2604.09718, self-named 'Agentic Compilation', labeled 'AgentJIT' in the frozen spec) compiles from open natural-language user intent plus a sanitized DOM in a single LLM call, and it does so behind a MANDATORY per-blueprint human review gate; the other four consulted sources bind by recorded live behaviour (arXiv:2607.04542, arXiv:2608.02680), by a hand-authored YAML specification (arXiv:2604.05150), or do not bind tasks at all (arXiv:2605.04107). (2) NO SYSTEM IN THIS PACKET PUBLISHES A GOAL-TO-ARTIFACT BINDING ERROR RATE. arXiv:2604.09718 reports JSON-schema validity (80-94% on 110 internal compile attempts) and execution accuracy conditional on validity (95-98%), from which the audit recomputes zero-shot end-to-end task success of 76.00%-90.24%; it publishes no abstention rate and no human-intervention rate, and its Section 5.1 states that reliance on proprietary enterprise DOMs 'limits independent replication of the specific execution payloads'. arXiv:2608.02680 explicitly publishes no compile/decline rate. arXiv:2604.05150's 4% compile-failure rate is a simulated ablation. arXiv:2607.04542 publishes gate refusal counts but binds by recording. Therefore the frozen C1 conjunct is not satisfied and this packet does NOT establish that SPIDER's differentiated semantic-resolution component is externally occupied; it also does not establish that it is unoccupied, because one of the five mandated targets (COVENANT) was never located and is unmeasured. (3) REGIME BOUNDARIES - reproducible author-reported reference points, all on distributions the packet itself certifies as incomparable to SPIDER's alias-OOD, all author-self-evaluated on author-self-authored or proprietary benchmarks with zero independent replication, and all with unrecorded accounting conventions: arXiv:2607.04542 87.1% of 560 witnessed-deterministic spans over four families (audit-recomputed 0.8714), K=8 recompile stride, 59.0 to 2.3 microdollars per item, 6.4x as a TOTAL-STREAM-SPEND ratio (17,692/2,775 = 6.375) against a per-item ratio of 25.65x, 48.9% silent wrongness (133/272) under a deliberately loose guard, 65.7 ms measured compiled-answer latency against an 18.2 microsecond trivial-artifact dispatch floor, one 100.0%-deterministic family REFUSED at all three rungs; arXiv:2604.05150 break-even ~17 transactions (9,600/552 = 17.39), 57x and 84x token reduction at 1,000 transactions, 40x TCO at 1M transactions/month against a fixed 500 USD/month infra line present in every row (inference-only 390.9x), 4.5 ms P50; arXiv:2605.04107 >=51% formal schema-compression bound, 50-72% token savings, the only artifact verifiably runnable without an LLM key, browser or docker; arXiv:2604.09718 0.002-0.092 USD per compilation, M=500 executions of one compiled profile, N=5. (4) CONTROLS - PC-MV6-REPRODUCIBILITY reproduces the prior packet's parameter set exactly (verified against EXP-INTEL-36249068574 and against the papers), which establishes extraction faithfulness but is intra-lineage and is not verification; NC-FABRICATED-BINDING-CLAIMS reproduces at zero occurrences but is a literal-string search with no power against the mis-identification failure that actually occurred. (5) NOT ESTABLISHED: any comparability of these numbers to SPIDER's alias-OOD; any independent replication of any reported number; any runnability for four of five artifacts; any build-cost or amortization convention usable for Product's break-even as transmitted; any abstention or human-intervention rate. DOWNSTREAM CONTRACT: Graph and Product may treat 'no external system publishes a goal-to-artifact binding error rate' as the standing external bar, which keeps C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE unoccupied-but-unmeasured rather than settled; they may NOT treat Agentic Compilation's 80-94% as an external binding error rate to beat, and they may NOT treat B-MV6-NO-MEMORY-EXECUTOR as a single validated baseline (it is a composite whose 18.2 microsecond floor understates the same source's measured 65.7 ms compiled-answer latency by ~3,610x). The prior cycle's inherited warning that the external convergence does not cleanly falsify SPIDER's direction is confirmed and strengthened: on the corrected reading, the external convergence is also not a clean confirmation that it occupies the differentiated component.

unresolved: Adjudication reserved for the Director: the frozen prereg.md Section 8 table states that MV2 failure carries the consequence MEASUREMENT_INVALID, and this audit finds MV2 was not satisfied as frozen (inference-only runnability for arXiv:2604.09718 and arXiv:2608.02680, no repository existing for either). This audit returns status=REVISE rather than MEASUREMENT_INVALID because the error direction is conservative - it produced a 'not runnable' verdict rather than a positive claim - and because the packet's central extractions were independently reproduced from primary sources, so the packet retains decision-relevant content that would be destroyed by voiding the whole transaction. A Director applying the prereg table literally to the GATE CLAIM (mv2_pass=true) rather than to the transaction should restate the producer's status to MEASUREMENT_INVALID at MV2 while preserving the extracted numbers as RAW EVIDENCE. This audit does not make that substitution and does not encode the gate failure as a scientific negative result.

The mandated target 'COVENANT' (request.json director_mandate.allocating question, prereg.md Section 5) was never located. Whether a paper by that name exists at all, or whether the mandate's name was simply a mislabel for arXiv:2608.02680, is not determinable from this packet. 1 of 5 frozen targets is therefore unmeasured; per AGENTS.md this is missing evidence, NOT a negative finding about COVENANT, and it must not be read as 'COVENANT does not publish a binding error rate'.

Whether arXiv:2604.09718's 80-94% figure could be obtained on a non-proprietary, independently replicable workload. The paper declines this by design (Section 5.1) and no reproduction exists in this environment. Until such a number exists on a public distribution, C-SEMANTIC-RESOLVE has no external numeric bar to beat, and Graph's next_gate ('unseen-goal resolution with applicability/abstention calibration') has no published external comparator.

Whether the frozen C2 threshold 'at least three of the five systems' is met on a name-level or artifact-level reading. On an artifact reading it is met (3 of 5 papers). On a name-level reading it is 2 clean plus 1 that requires counting arXiv:2604.05150 against the name 'Auto/AGI Compiler' while that name's other source arXiv:2605.04107 is recorded as 'not applicable regime'. The design defect is in the frozen spec, which is immutable, so this cannot be repaired inside this experiment; the Director must set the reading when adjudicating.

Whether the reported regime boundaries can be transferred to SPIDER's alias-OOD at all. The packet answers NO for every system (c3_comparability_assessed=true, all INCOMPARABLE), which leaves Product's break-even and Frontier's headroom decomposition without a usable external target despite report.md Section 5 supplying one. No transfer function, and none is derivable from five incomparable benchmarks.

Whether the extraction's residual errors are systematic. This audit found and corrected one census attribution error (F5 17.5%) and confirmed the other material numbers against sources, so per-record error rate appears low, but 1 of 12 records used a secondary source in a primary-source field and 1 quote is a two-section splice. The pipeline's error rate on mis-scoped metrics is not bounded by this sample.

Whether the 'binding error rate' construct demanded by frozen C1 is measurable at all in any of the five systems, or whether the construct itself is under-specified. The frozen condition conflates compile-schema validity, execution correctness conditional on validity, abstention rate, and human-intervention rate into one term; the only source that reports any of these reports the first two and omits the last two. A future packet would need the condition decomposed into separately reportable quantities before it can be satisfied or falsified.

Whether the mandatory-HITL design of arXiv:2604.09718 generalizes.
